controls.label: Sign out
controls.reason: Second rendered device row uses its own session identity.

controls.label: Sign out all other sessions
controls.reason: Atomically revoke all own sessions except current after recent authentication.

controls.label: Report unrecognised activity
controls.reason: Persist a restricted security task and administrator notification linked to the reported session.

controls.label: Current password
controls.reason: Password input remains transient; explicit command uses framework verification/history and never caches secrets.

controls.label: New password
controls.reason: Password input remains transient; explicit command uses framework verification/history and never caches secrets.

controls.label: Confirm new password
controls.reason: New-password confirmation is a transient equality check; only the actual password is submitted and server policy remains authoritative.

controls.label: Forgotten your password?
controls.reason: Queue a demo reset with non-enumerating response and single-use token.

controls.label: Sign out everywhere
controls.reason: Prototype handler explicitly signs out other sessions; current session retained and UI label clarifies that behaviour.

controls.label: Set up now
controls.reason: Enter enrolment flow; enabled state changes only after a valid code.

controls.label: Set up authenticator app
controls.reason: Equivalent authenticator setup entry point.

controls.label: Why we ask for this
controls.reason: Static explanation of MFA purpose; no read or domain mutation needed.

controls.label: Recovery codes
controls.reason: Security correction: previously issued plaintext codes cannot be retrieved from hashes. Show remaining count and offer recently authenticated replacement; reveal new codes once.

controls.label: View recovery codes
controls.reason: Same recovery-code security correction; never add plaintext code storage to reproduce mock display.

controls.label: Regenerate recovery codes
controls.reason: Generate new single-use codes and atomically invalidate old codes after recent authentication.

controls.label: Replace authenticator app
controls.reason: Replacement leaves current authenticator effective until new enrolment is confirmed.

controls.label: Turn off two-factor authentication
controls.reason: Confirmation verifies credentials/code and role-required MFA policy before disabling.

controls.label: Sign back in
controls.reason: Open sign-in and authenticate real local credentials; do not restore a hardcoded user or session.

controls.label: Other active sessions
controls.reason: Literal navigation to account / Sessions & activity; display only. Record IDs come from selected scoped row, not fixed prototype IDs. Opening capture does not save, issue or send; its confirmed commands are separately reviewed.

controls.label: Request change
controls.reason: Persist requested email change; nominated second approver is routing only, no fabricated approval. Required audit/security notifications cannot be disabled.

controls.label: User
controls.reason: Selected subject is the authorised target user ID for identity request; client input cannot select an inaccessible user.

controls.label: Current email
controls.reason: Current email is read from server state and not trusted as proof or editable identity input.

controls.label: New email address
controls.reason: Email-change proposal requires independent approval; routing approver is not proof of approval and required notifications cannot be suppressed.

controls.label: Second approver
controls.reason: Email-change proposal requires independent approval; routing approver is not proof of approval and required notifications cannot be suppressed.

controls.label: Notify the user
controls.reason: Email-change proposal requires independent approval; routing approver is not proof of approval and required notifications cannot be suppressed.

controls.label: Copy all codes
controls.reason: Copy newly generated recovery codes from current one-time UI state to clipboard after explicit click; no secret-retrieval API or plaintext persistence.

controls.label: Codes
controls.reason: Codes are one-time secret display/copy state from successful generation, not an editable/persisted field.

controls.label: Confirm with your password
controls.reason: Password is transient reauthentication for generating new codes; old plaintext codes cannot be retrieved.

controls.label: Turn off
controls.reason: Verify recent password and MFA/recovery proof plus required-role policy before disabling.

controls.label: Confirm with your password
controls.reason: MFA disable requires verified password/code and role policy; never a client-side boolean toggle.

controls.label: Reason
controls.reason: MFA disable requires verified password/code and role policy; never a client-side boolean toggle.

controls.label: Authenticator app
controls.reason: Authenticator-app choice supplies setup instructions only; all offered compatible apps use the same TOTP protocol.

controls.label: Name this device
controls.reason: Device name is optional enrolment metadata; persist at setup start with recent-auth proof.

controls.label: Continue
controls.reason: Advance by current stage: start pending enrolment once, then verify six-digit code at verification stage. Never enable MFA based on local UI state.

controls.label: Cancel setup
controls.reason: Cancel any pending enrolment; before one exists only close setup. Destroy temporary secret/code hashes and clear local secrets.

controls.label: Learn more
controls.reason: Display static MFA help without sending credentials or modifying enrolment.

controls.label: Continue
controls.reason: Reuse current unexpired enrolment on stage changes; confirm TOTP before showing one-time recovery codes.

controls.label: Back
controls.reason: Move back within the same unexpired enrolment; do not regenerate secrets or recover already-cleared codes.

controls.label: Cancel setup
controls.reason: Cancel pending setup server-side and clear displayed secret/recovery codes; never disable existing active MFA.

controls.label: 6-digit code
controls.reason: Six-digit code is transient secret input; submit to rate-limited enrolment verification, never persist in form history/logs.

controls.label: Cannot scan
controls.reason: Show manual setup key derived from the currently held otpauth URI; never put the secret in analytics, URLs or local storage.

controls.label: Copy all
controls.reason: Copy only currently displayed one-time recovery codes with user gesture. Clipboard failure is shown; no server retrieval of plaintext hashes.

controls.label: I have saved these recovery codes somewhere safe
controls.reason: Local acknowledgement gates activation and maps to recoveryCodesSaved=true; toggling alone does not enable MFA.

controls.label: Finish and turn on
controls.reason: Activate only verified unexpired enrolment after saved-code acknowledgement. Promote secret/hashes atomically and clear plaintext. Retry reads current account state; it never returns codes again.
